description: This Java source file defines a Fragment class for an Android application that serves as the drop target in a drag-and-drop operation between different apps. It manages drag events on an ImageView, processes dropped URIs (including permission handling for content URIs), restores state, and provides user interface controls related to permissions.

classes.name: DropTargetFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class implementing a drag-and-drop target interface for images, handling permissions for URI access and restoring state.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes the ImageView and drag listener, restores saved URI state.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current image URI state.
